tools.name: book_call
tools.description: Books a free 15-minute fit call with Joe Hill, by video, at a start time from get_availability. Confirm the time and every detail with the person before calling this. Joe's calendar invite goes to the email given.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "book_call" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Books a free 15-minute fit call with Joe Hill, by video, at a start time from get_availability. Confirm the time and every detail with the person before calling…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
